messages:
Ellen (SRE): Planned: gradual capacity reclaim test on 2026-11-02 02:00-02:10 UTC targeting eu-west-2. Purpose: verify autoscaler and routing under steady reclaim (not a failover). Expect small latency upticks and 4xx for a minute.

Ellen (SRE): Plan outline: 1) mark 25% of region capacity as reclaiming over 5m, 2) monitor reroute_rate and cache_hit_ratio, 3) run cache rewarm for top prefixes.

oncall-bot: Maintenance window created: 2026-11-02 02:00-02:10 UTC. Tag: sim_reclaim_1900012345.

Marco (infra): Command to mark reclaiming: `redwoodctl capacity set --region eu-west-2 --state reclaiming --percent 25 --grace 300`. I'll add `--no-evict` flag.

Ivy (platform): I'll pause non-critical canaries 01:30-03:00 UTC and label test traffic `x-sim=reclaim`. Production routes stay pinned.

Ellen (SRE): SLO adjustments: mute latency_p99 alerts and raise p95 threshold to 1.1s for window. Auto-revert at 02:30. If error_rate > 4% for >4m escalate to #outage.

Marco (infra): Quick ask: enable prefer-quantized for test traffic to reduce GPU pressure?

Ivy (platform): OK for test traffic only. Add header `x-model-tier: quantized` to sim requests.

sonar-bot: Cache priming job scheduled at 01:55 UTC. Job id: sonar-1900012345-prime.

Ellen (SRE): Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/sre/capacity-reclaim-runbook. Keep messages short during window and post outcomes here. Debrief 02:20 UTC in #eng-sre.
